name: The Abbot's Bride
summary: The Abbot of St. Markovia is stitching a bride for the lord of Barovia from Krezk's dead, and believes a wife will cure him.

stages.journal: The Abbot of St. Markovia keeps the abbey above Krezk with the Belview family he has been 'improving'. He looks like a young monk and lights candles with his fingertips. Krezk is afraid of him.
objectives: Learn what the Abbot is working on
stages.hint: Keep talking to the Abbot in the abbey church above Krezk and ask what he's working on.

stages.journal: The Abbot is making a bride for Strahd, sewn from Krezk's dead, and believes a wife will gentle him. He asked us for a wedding dress. In return he offered to heal the burgomaster's son.
objectives: Find a wedding dress, perhaps in Krezk
Or decide not to help him
stages.hint: Ask in Krezk for a wedding dress: Anna Krezkova kept hers. Or decide not to help the Abbot.

stages.journal: We have a wedding dress for the Abbot's bride.
objectives: Take the dress to the Abbot in the abbey church
stages.hint: Take the dress to the Abbot in the church of the Abbey of St. Markovia.

stages.journal: We gave the Abbot the dress. He woke his bride, Vasilka, in the church that same hour.
objectives: Decide what becomes of the Abbot's work
stages.hint: Talk to the Abbot in the abbey church and decide what becomes of his work.

stages.journal: We let the Abbot have his wedding. Clovin drove Vasilka down the road to the castle in a white dress, and the Abbot went down to Krezk to keep his bargain.
The Abbot understood what he had done. He laid his bride to rest, went down to Krezk once more, and then walked up the mountain to wait for a judgement that may never come.
Vasilka was destroyed defending her wedding. The Abbot sits in his church and will not speak.
The Abbot of St. Markovia is dead. Whatever he was sent here to be, he is light and a brown habit now.
The Abbot wanted Ireena instead of his stitched bride. We left with her. He means to write to the castle and tell its lord where she sleeps.
